gitvc01.title: 01 / Inspect the development line
gitvc01.caption: Start inside the fictional atlas-tools repository. One task is already waiting in the active development line.
lines:
Open dev line (Project): v0.0.x (#19)
   Patch: rel p #<issue>   | Minor: rel m   | Major: rel M

- [TODO] #1  Correct the path alias function

gitvc02.title: 02 / Create a fix and a feature
gitvc02.caption: rel fix creates a fix issue; rel init creates a feature issue. The issue numbers continue the same fictional session.
lines:
Open dev line found: v0.0.x (#19)
Creating items (kind=fix):
  • created: #2 (FIX) Handle missing export folders
rel init "Add a project summary command"

Open dev line found: v0.0.x (#19)
Creating items (kind=feature):
  • created: #3 Add a project summary command

gitvc03.title: 03 / Review the queue
gitvc03.caption: The overview groups feature tasks and fixes. Use rel init for new feature tasks; rel task is not a supported command.
lines:
Open dev line (Project): v0.0.x (#19)
   Patch: rel p #<issue>   | Minor: rel m   | Major: rel M

- [TODO] #1  Correct the path alias function
- [TODO] #3  Add a project summary command
- [FIX]  #2  Handle missing export folders

gitvc04.title: 04 / Tag a completed issue
gitvc04.caption: Issue #1 becomes Done after its patch tag is created. The feature and the fix remain in the development line.
lines:
[info] example-lab/atlas-tools
[info] Tag to create: v0.0 -> v0.0.1
[info] Tag created: v0.0.1 (at main)
[info] project item #1 marked as Done.

Open dev line (Project): v0.0.x (#19)
   Patch: rel p #<issue>   | Minor: rel m   | Major: rel M

- [done] #1  Correct the path alias function
- [TODO] #3  Add a project summary command

gitvc05.title: 05 / Publish a minor delivery
gitvc05.caption: Illustrative state transition, not a literal command log: complete the feature, publish v0.1 and carry the unfinished fix into v0.1.x.

gitvc06.title: 06 / Publish a major delivery
gitvc06.caption: Illustrative state transition, not a literal command log: reconcile the remaining fix before publishing the major version. The major command marks all current project items Done.
